ValidationRule.description: Bid Source, Prime or Sub Contractor, Received Date, Due Date, and Actual Bid Release Date are required to leave Bid Under Review. Records created before 2026-08-31 and Bypass CapStrat Validation holders are exempt.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT($Permission.Bypass_CapStrat_Validation) && OR(ISNEW(), CreatedDate >= DATETIMEVALUE("2026-08-31 00:00:00")) && NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(CapStrat_Stage__c))) && NOT(ISPICKVAL(CapStrat_Stage__c, "Bid Under Review")) && ( ISBLANK(TEXT(Bid_Source__c)) || ISBLANK(TEXT(Primary_Bidder__c)) || ISBLANK(Received_Date__c) || ISBLANK(Due_Date__c) || ISBLANK(Actual_Bid_Release_Date__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To move this Capture Strategy past Bid Under Review, first fill in: Bid Source, Prime or Sub Contractor, Received Date, Due Date, and Actual Bid Release Date.
